authorization: An independently validated external English-core artifact requires five rank-16 residual routes while the sealed V24 host accepts exactly four. One isolated V25 successor may add only the fifth clarification mapping and residual geometry needed to test that immutable payload.
objective: Construct-certify one isolated zero-host-parameter V24 successor that accepts exactly five physically isolated residual routes, maps only clarification to route four, preserves the original four-route ordering and every inherited execution/security behavior, and activates at most one residual route per token.

implementation_boundary.v25_package_requirement: A package must be explicitly signed for V25, declare clarification_route_isolation and allocation_bounded_tensor_adoption, contain exactly five rank-16 residual routes, and declare the fixed residual capability order abstention, coherence, fluent_realization, tone_control, clarification. V24 packages fail closed.
implementation_boundary.runtime_change: Only clarification changes from the V24 no-residual strong path to residual route four. All other capability mapping, routing, model math, tokenizer behavior, prompt-span behavior, lexical guard, format path, cache state, and allocation-bounded activation remain unchanged.
implementation_boundary.sparsity: No token may activate more than one residual route.

decision_rule: Implement only new isolated V25 source/evaluation/test files. Pass construct certification only if sealed sources remain byte-exact, the exact fixed five-route contract is fail-closed, route-four clarification execution is physical and exclusive, every inherited V24 mode remains exact, focused and complete tests pass, and the unchanged campaign verifier still passes all eight sealed phases.
claim_boundary: Generic isolated V25 five-route host construct only. No external artifact, English quality, information minimum, physical speed or memory, campaign-phase recertification, or ABI-superiority claim.
